name: Ghostlaunch
tagline: Test your startup idea on real clicks, not compliments

Then we launch, and the people who loved it don't show up. Ghostlaunch tests an idea on what people do, not what they say. You describe your idea in a few sentences, and in 7 days you get: 1.
